watch_list.summary: Asked whether agents should modify skills, Lauren says it depends: stale updates are fine, otherwise she has the agent run an eval first.

watch_list.short_title: Gavin Baker's Grok Bot use cases
watch_list.summary: Quoting a16z, she highlights Gavin Baker building a podcast summarizer, Substack and X summarizers, and an X sentiment tracker in seconds with Grok Bot, work that took him hours in Claude Code.

watch_list.short_title: Human approval on core and infra PRs
watch_list.summary: On when a flood of PRs still needs review: more core packages and infra have agentic codeowners, so those still require human approval before merging.
